label: sdc01_0150_shop_01
text: Step right up for a game of Ogre Oustin’!\nSo, y’all want to have a go?

label: sdc01_0150_shop_02
text: Hey, you’re one of those kids that came all the\nway from Paldea, right?

label: sdc01_0150_shop_03
text: I can’t very well take money from a guest!\nHave a go, on the house!

label: sdc01_0150_sister_01
text: You’re up for a run of Ogre Oustin’, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0150_sister_02
text: I did one just now. It was pretty easy—for me,\nthat is.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0150_sister_03
text: My score was [VAR 0x0205(0001,002C)]! Think you can do better?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
